title: Discoverability & Exposure Surface
brief: Make capabilities discoverable across MCP tools, API routes, UI components, and dispatchers. Prevent important capabilities from being buried in one internal path. Ensure every product-relevant capability has at least two exposure surfaces.

units.title: Audit current exposure: map each capability to its access paths (MCP/route/UI/dispatcher)
Identify buried capabilities: product-relevant items with only one internal access path
Wire additional exposure surfaces for buried capabilities (MCP tool, route, or UI entry point)
Validate discoverability: every product-relevant capability reachable via >=2 surfaces

exit_conditions: Every product-relevant capability has >=2 exposure surfaces
No critical capability buried in single internal path
